## Current Role

**Program Technician** — Multnomah County Health Department, Portland, OR *(June 2025- Present)*

At Multnomah County Health Department, I worked with across Health Department divsions and departments to develop a county wide Community Health Improvement Plan (CHIP) using community driven data. To do this I collaborated with other Public Health practitioners to:

- Lead and coordinate the qualitative analysis of focus group sessions to capture input from over 300 community members to understand and revise CHIP priority areas to align with community needs.

- Develop and code a Collaboration Tool using GoogleSQL containing over 450 activities done by programs across Public Health and Behavioral Divisions to promote collaboration and create greater visibility across the broader health department.

- Regularly presented findings and CHIP progress to department leadership and program managers to ensure communication and progress of the larger CHIP process.


## Relevant Projects

**Exploring Multifaceted Approaches to Engaging Community Voice to Assess and Understand Community Health Needs** — see the [Projects page](pheal_capstone.qmd) for the full story.

- By examining multiple approaches, this project documents and encourages inclusive and collaborative community assessments that are foundational to public health practice.
